source_basis.use: Original nine architectural photographs, materials, four storeys, design 2003, completion 2005, and total floor area 1931 square metres.
PDF pages 38-40 library photographs and plans 1F-4F; the page 37 table conflict is retained and other buildings on adjacent page portions excluded.
School/campus positioning only; not a dimensional plan.
Official PHOTO2 layer and surrounding retained tiles; same-elevation main-roof scale estimate only, capture date unknown.

accepted_evidence_limits: Early completed exterior represented by architect 2005 project; actual photograph dates unknown; not 2026 current-condition survey.
Main roof approximately 20.4 by 18.9 m, south service depth about 4 m, roof/core heights about 18/20 m are estimates; 1931 square metres is total floor area, not footprint.
Architect photo 03 is NW view showing north and west, not east. East circles are supported by interior photographs 07/09; exact east pattern remains schematic.
The plan orientation is right=N, top=W, left=S, bottom=E; the campus diagram uses a different rotation.
Do not create four basement levels or remove the second stair from the conflicting 2004/underground4/stair1 table.
South hidden elevations and old-library connection are low-detail approximations; no mirrored north facade and no neighboring buildings.
West lower-floor repeated circles are generalized where source photographs are obscured; exact panel counts/dimensions at every floor are not claimed.
L-stairs are thickened ramps/platforms, tree branches are simplified supports joined into floors, frames/glazing are thickened, and small signage characters/interiors are omitted.
STL glazing is a solid shell. Render transparency is only a material depiction; opaque single-material printing hides the interior stair. Transparent printing and post-processing are untested.
No reference photographs, PDF crops, or orthophotos were used as textures or included in this public-safe review.
Final manufacture, support removal, resin drainage, numerical thickness guarantees, and actual print success are outside this review.

new_school_check.method: Independent recount and alias search of the post-TMU complete snapshot already verified against remote by the publication task; no new live GitHub request by this reviewer.
